channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Khilaaf culus oo ka dhex taagan Wasiirka Duulista iyo Maareeyaha Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliya
item.description: Khilaaf maamul oo u dhexeeya Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya iyo Maareeyaha Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka, Axmed Macallin, ayaa dhaliyey su'aalo la xiriira awood-qaybsiga, madax-bannaanida hay'adaha dowladda iyo cidda leh mas'uuliyadda ugu dambeysa ee kormeerka duulista rayidka dalka.

item.title: Jannik Sinner oo qalliin yar lagu sameeyay jilibka midig, toddobaadyo kahor Australian Open
item.description: Jannik Sinner, oo ah ciyaaryahanka labaad ee tennis-ka adduunka, ayaa 24 November shaaciyay in lagu sameeyay qalliin yar oo jilibkiisa midig ah, toddoba toddobaad kahor bilowga Australian Open ee Janaayo.

item.title: Luka Modric oo dhaawac muruq ah dartiis u seegaya kulanka Milan ee Olympiacos
item.description: Kooxda AC Milan ayaa la sheegay in Luka Modric uu seegi doono kulanka Khamiista ee Europa League ee Olympiacos, kadib dhaawac muruqa bowdada midig ah oo uu ka soo gaaray kulankii Frosinone.

item.title: Abiy Axmed oo soo jeediyay in Itoobiya ay martigeliso wada-hadal loo dhan yahay oo Suudaan ah
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed, ayaa 24 November ku dhawaaqay hindise uu Itoobiya ku martigelinayo kuna maalgelinayo wada-hadal qaran oo loo dhan yahay oo dhexmara dhinacyada Suudaan, si dagaalka loo soo afjaro.

item.title: FA-da oo buriyay kaarkii cas ee Leny Yoro ka helay kulankii Liverpool
item.description: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta England (FA) ayaa 24 November buriyay kaarkii cas ee daafaca Manchester United Leny Yoro uu ka helay kulankii Axadda ee Anfield, kaas oo Liverpool ay ku guulaysatay 4-0.

item.title: Freddy Peralta oo heshiis shan sano ah oo $125 milyan ah la galay Baltimore Orioles
item.description: Tuuraha baseball-ka Freddy Peralta ayaa la sheegay inuu 24 November heshiis shan sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $125 milyan la galay kooxda Baltimore Orioles ee MLB.

item.title: 11 qof oo ku dhaawacmay weerar Xuutiyiinta ay ku qaadeen dabaq ku yaal xarunta maaliyadda ee Riyadh
item.description: Difaaca Madaniga ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegay in 24 November 11 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen weerar Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku qaadeen dabaq ku yaal degmada maaliyadda ee magaalada Riyadh.

item.title: Agaasime Cabdiweli Timacadde: Hoggaan dhiirrigelinaya horumarka aqoonsiga qaranka
item.description: Maareeyaha Guud ee NIRA, Cabdiweli Cali Cabdulle (Timacadde), ayaa wada dadaallo lagu horumarinayo nidaamka aqoonsiga qaranka, dardargelinta diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta iyo xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah, isagoo xarunta hay'adda ku qaabilay Isu-duwaha Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, George Conway.

item.title: Chicago Cubs oo heshiis lix sano ah oo $120 milyan ah la gashay ciyaaryahanka Japan Teruaki Sato
item.description: Kooxda Chicago Cubs ee baseball-ka Mareykanka ayaa la sheegay inay 24 November heshiis lix sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $120 milyan la gashay garaacaha reer Japan Teruaki Sato.

item.title: Connor Bedard oo qalliin garabka ah kadib afar bilood ka maqnaanaya Chicago Blackhawks
item.description: Kooxda Chicago Blackhawks ee NHL ayaa shaacisay in kabtankeeda Connor Bedard uu maqnaan doono afar bilood, kadib qalliin lagu sameeyay garabkiisa midig.

item.title: Bayern Munich oo Lille ugu ambabaxday Michael Olise la'aantiis, kulanka Champions League ee Arbacada
item.description: Bayern Munich ayaa kulanka Champions League ee ay Arbacada ku booqanayso Lille ku ciyaari doonta iyadoo aan haysan Michael Olise, kaas oo aan ka mid ahayn liiska safarka ee kooxda.

item.title: Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo dadka Ulleungdo gabbaad u dirtay markii diyaarado Ruush ah u soo dhowaadeen
item.description: Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa Talaadadii diyaarado dagaal kicisay, dadka ku nool jasiiradda Ulleungdo ee bariga dalkana ku amartay inay gabbaad galaan, kadib markii ciidamada cirka ee Ruushka ay u soo dhowaadeen hawada dalka.

item.title: Farmaajo oo soo dhaweeyay booqashada Museveni, farriin siyaasadeedna u diray hoggaanka Soomaaliya
item.description: Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa soo dhaweeyay booqashada la filayo in Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni uu ku yimaado Muqdisho, wuxuuna hoggaanka dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan Dastuuri ah.

item.title: Inter oo qiyaastii bil waayi doonta Hakan Çalhanoğlu kadib dhaawac murqaha bowdada ah
item.description: Inter Milan ayaa Talaadadii xaqiijisay in Hakan Çalhanoğlu uu dhaawac murqo ka soo gaaray bowdada midig, waxaana la filayaa inuu ka maqnaado garoonka ilaa afar toddobaad.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Indonesia oo ka wada hadlay iskaashi caafimaad iyo musharraxnimada Indonesia ee hoggaanka WHO
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa 24 November Muqdisho ku qaabilay Wasiirka Caafimaadka Indonesia, Budi Gunadi Sadikin, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo.

item.title: Zelensky oo qiray in Ukraine ay drone ku weerartay markabka xamuulka Ruushka ee Sparta II ee Gacanka Finland
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu masuul ka yahay weerar drone oo dhammaadkii toddobaadka lagu qaaday markab xamuul oo Ruush ah oo ku sugnaa Gacanka Finland.

item.title: CAS oo Senegal u celisay horyaalnimada AFCON 2025, go'aankii CAF ee Morocco siiyay koobkana la buriyay
item.description: Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ayaa Talaadadii go'aamisay in Senegal ay tahay koobka Qaramada Afrika 2025, iyadoo buriyay go'aankii guddiga racfaanka CAF ee horyaalnimada u wareejiyay Morocco.

item.title: Millwall oo noqotay kooxdii ugu horreysay ee EFL ee qayb garoonkeeda la xiro heeso takoor ah dartood
item.description: Guddi anshax oo ka tirsan Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta England (FA) ayaa Millwall ku amray inay kulan horyaal ku ciyaarto iyadoo qayb ka mid ah garoonkeeda The Den la xiray, kuna ganaaxay £70,000.

item.title: Luis Enrique oo sheegay in PSG aysan ka ooyi doonin dhaawacyada Doué iyo Kvaratskhelia kahor kulanka Roma
item.description: Tababaraha Paris Saint-Germain, Luis Enrique, ayaa kahor kulanka Champions League ee Roma sheegay in kooxdu ay weli tahay mid xooggan inkastoo ay waysay Désiré Doué iyo Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.

item.title: Lacagta Iran ee rial-ka oo hoos ugu dhacday heerkii ugu hooseeyay kadib cunaqabateyn cusub oo Mareykan
item.description: Lacagta Iran ee rial-ka ayaa Talaadadii gaartay heerkii ugu hooseeyay ee abid marka loo eego doollarka Mareykanka, maalin kadib markii Washington ay cunaqabateyn cusub ku soo rogtay shabakadaha maaliyadeed ee Iran.

item.title: Kenya: Ruto oo Hustler Fund ku kordhiyay 5 bilyan oo shilin, amaahda qofkiina laga dhigay ilaa 150,000
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqay in dowladdu ay 5 bilyan oo shilin oo dheeraad ah ku darayso sanduuqa amaahda ee Hustler Fund, isla markaana 4.5 milyan oo amaah-qaate ay heli karaan amaah gaaraysa 150,000 oo shilin.

item.title: Juventus oo kahor kulanka Omonia la tacaalaysa dhaawacyada Alajbegovic, Kalulu iyo Nico González
item.description: Kerim Alajbegovic, Pierre Kalulu iyo Nico González ayaa Talaadadii mar kale tababar gaar ah sameeyay, iyadoo Juventus ay diyaar u tahay kulanka Europa League ee Khamiista ay la ciyaarayso Omonia Nicosia.

item.title: XIISADDA SIYAASADEED: Xildhibaan Dayah Axmed Cumar oo eedeymo culus u jeediyay Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya
item.description: Xildhibaan Dayah Axmed Cumar oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay Facebook ku eedeeyay Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jamac TikTok), inuu khatar ku yahay dalka iyo jaajuusnimo. Eedeymahan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin.

item.title: Cali Jeyte oo dowladda federaalka uga baaqay gargaar degdeg ah oo la gaarsiiyo dadka tabaalaysan ee gobolka Hiiraan
item.description: Cali Jeyte Cismaan, oo xafiiska Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya uga qaybsan arrimaha ciidamada difaaca deegaanka, ayaa 24 November ka codsaday dowladda federaalka in si degdeg ah gargaar loogu gaarsiiyo dadka nugul ee gobolka Hiiraan.

item.title: Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug iyo ku-simaha safiirka Mareykanka oo ka wada hadlay doorashooyinka iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed Xasan, ayaa 24 November wadahadal telefoon la yeeshay ku-simaha safiirka Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz, oo ku saabsanaa siyaasadda dalka, doorashooyinka iyo amniga.

item.title: Udinese: Xaaladda caafimaad ee guddoomiyaha kooxda, Gianpaolo Pozzo, oo soo fiicnaanaysa
item.description: Kooxda Udinese ayaa Talaadada bayaan ku sheegtay in xaaladda caafimaad ee guddoomiyaheeda Gianpaolo Pozzo, oo isbitaal loogu daweynayo oof-wareen, ay si tartiib ah u soo hagaagayso.

item.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay kooxda Xuutiyiinta iyo 4 ka mid ah saraakiisheeda
item.description: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Talaadada ku dhawaaqday cunaqabateyn ka dhan ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen iyo 4 ka mid ah saraakiisheeda, iyadoo ku eedeysay gardarro cusub oo ka dhan ah Yemen gudaheeda iyo Sacuudi Carabiya.

item.title: Wasiirka Caafimaadka: Ku dhowaad 400 xarumood oo caafimaad ayaa xirmay kadib joojinta kaalmada USAID
item.description: Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Soomaaliya, Cali Xaaji Aadan, ayaa Talaadada sheegay in ku dhowaad 400 xarumood oo caafimaad iyo dhowr xarumood oo guurguura ay shaqada joojiyeen, kadib markii ay dhammaatay maalgelintii ay ka heli jireen hay'adda USAID ee Mareykanka.

item.title: Crystal Palace Women oo 3 dhibcood laga jaray WSL kadib isbeddel ciyaartoy oo xeerka ka baxsan
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Crystal Palace ayaa 3 dhibcood laga jaray horyaalka Women's Super League (WSL), kadib markii ay ciyaartoy ku beddeleen 4 fursadood oo kala duwan ciyaartii ay September 1-0 kaga badiyeen Everton.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo markii ugu horreysay hirgelisay nidaamka Lambarka Aqoonsiga Canshuur-bixiyaha (TIN)
item.description: Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka ee Soomaaliya ayaa hirgelisay nidaamka Lambarka Aqoonsiga Canshuur-bixiyaha (TIN), kaas oo loogu talagalay casriyeynta maamulka canshuuraha iyo fududeynta diiwaangelinta ganacsiyada.
